findings.settlement: private.farkle_settle_v1 settles once and ends in game_over, or session_ended when pending_session_end was set.
findings.continuation: No Farkle postgame RPC is deployed. private.advance_standard_postgame admits only holm, holm-game, horses and ship-captain-crew.
findings.recovery: private.sync_game_timer_registry registers standard_postgame only for holm, holm-game, horses and ship-captain-crew. Farkle's round timer is cancelled at completion.
findings.genericBoundary: private.farkle_guard_shared_v1 requires an exact Farkle authority claim for Farkle game/player writes. Generic client continuation is not an allowed fallback.
findings.creation: private.farkle_resolve_config_v1 rejects creation_enabled=false before checking admin/service/testConfiguration. The production flag therefore also excludes test-only admin creation.
findings.environments: Supabase branch listing contains only the production/default main branch. The running Docker stack run21-app-test-local belongs to rule-your-poker-run21-app-test and has neither private.farkle_release nor public.farkle_apply_action. It was only inspected.

nextDecision: Authorize an additive, isolated Farkle exact-identity postgame RPC/receipt and disconnect recovery through a narrow canonical timer-dispatch addition. Keep historical Wave 1 migration files and gameplay/scoring/settlement/control contracts unchanged; requalify affected deployed shared fingerprints. Use a separate local test instance for test-only creation; keep production gates unchanged.
qualification: Not run: no live route was enabled and no Wave 2 release or main integration was attempted. This is a boundary inspection, not a passing qualification.
